name: ios
title: iOS
description: iOS / Swift app development (SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, Xcode)

notes: Every test run installs the app on the booted simulator: two concurrent test runs kill each other's host, so only the tester holding the simulator lease runs tests. Builds are safe in parallel.
Environment recovery: pgrep -fl 'xcodebuild test'; xcrun simctl shutdown <udid> && xcrun simctl boot <udid>.
